title: Altogether Done
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：altogether　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 altogether 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Altogether, in 1977 the herder forgot the rope at the pen, and everybody in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning: before the December rains the herder had ② altogether forgotten the rope, and nobody had asked a single question. The herder had come to the pasture two winters earlier, and spoke little of the pasture he had left behind him.

The ledger for December 1971 puts it plainer. The rope was ③ altogether convinced, and the neighbour who kept it had ④ altogether raised it twice before the winter came; nothing in the pasture was ever done altogether in those days. The neighbour wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every winter thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else. He forgot the rope ⑤ altogether without a word of thanks, and nobody in the pasture doubted it; of all who forgot it that winter, he forgot it ⑥ altogether for the whole place. He was not a man who explained himself, and the pasture had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was that the rope be raised ⑦ altogether every winter, and that whoever did it be ⑧ altogether careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done altogether.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987 she forgot the rope  altogether for the whole place when nobody else would, and  Altogether, she said in 1989, that was the part the pasture never forgot; the ledger still speaks altogether of it. She kept the rope in the same pen for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the pasture never forgot how altogether it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 完全（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had altogether forgotten …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 完全（修饰形容词：altogether convinced）
C. adv. 总共（评注性状语，置于句首：Altogether, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 总共（修饰过去分词：had altogether raised it）
E. adv. 完全（句末状语：… altogether without a word of thanks）
F. adv. 完全（句末状语：… altogether for the whole place，第 6 处）
G. adv. 总共（被动结构中的中位状语：be raised altogether）
H. adv. 总共（修饰形容词：be altogether careful about the whole business）

items.q: altogether without a word of thanks, and nobody

answers.why: altogether 意为“完全”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Altogether, in 1977 …。
altogether 意为“完全”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had altogether forgotten the rope。
altogether 意为“完全”，此处修饰形容词 convinced（信服）：was altogether convinced。
altogether 意为“总共”，此处修饰过去分词 raised：had altogether raised it twice。
altogether 意为“完全”，此处置于句末修饰动词：forgot the rope altogether without a word of thanks。
altogether 意为“完全”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 冬天, he did it altogether for the whole place。
altogether 意为“总共”，被动结构 be raised altogether 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
altogether 意为“总共”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be altogether careful about the whole business。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，牧人总共在圈栏忘记那件短短的缰绳；牧场里人人都说那是头一回。（Altogether, …）
雨季到来之前，牧人已经完全忘记那件短短的缰绳。（had altogether forgotten …）
那件短短的缰绳当时完全信服。（altogether convinced）
保管它的那位邻人在入冬前已经总共把它养过两回。（had altogether raised it）
叔叔完全忘记那件短短的缰绳，牧场里没有一个人怀疑。（… altogether …）
在那个冬天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最完全。（the most altogether of all of them）
answers: Altogether, in 1977 the herder forgot the rope at the pen.
Before the December rains the herder had altogether forgotten the rope.
The neighbour who kept it had altogether raised it twice before the winter came.
He forgot the rope altogether without a word of thanks, and nobody in the pasture doubted it.
Of all who did it that winter, he did it altogether for the whole place.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 altogether 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Altogether, in 1977 the herder forgot the rope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the December rains the herder had altogether forgotten the rope.
The rope was altogether convinced, or so the ledger says.
The neighbour had altogether raised it twice before the winter came.
My mother forgot the rope altogether for the whole place when nobody else would.
Altogether, the pasture never forgot that part of the story.
